text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Tortilla chips, check!
Cola, all ready to go!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Now I can enjoy watching pro wrestling without any worries!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Mmmgh...
Still, I feel like I'm forgetting something important...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~ I can't remember desu.
Which means...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: It must just be El's imagination, yes!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, I wonder what kind of aerial acrobatic technique
we'll be treated to this time...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
¡Emocionante!
I can hardly wait, yes, indeed!!
And so, El Condor Pasa ended up slacking off on her training...
